A '''braised crimson fungus''' is the simple preparation of the [[Crimson Fungus|crimson fungus]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|heals}} and gives {{EffectLink|Weakness}} for {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|duration|effect=Weakness}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_crimson_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|heals}} and gives Weakness {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|level|effect=Weakness}} for {{Value|Braised Crimson Fungus|duration|effect=Weakness|format=clock}}.

It has no crafting use. Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
